question:
The passage states that "workplaces that foster supportive environments and encourage employees to discuss their mental health challenges tend to witness higher productivity and job satisfaction."

Which of the following inferences can be most reasonably drawn from this statement?

options.text: Productivity and job satisfaction in workplaces are determined only by the mental health of employees.
Encouraging open discussions about mental health at work can have a positive effect on overall work performance.
Employees will always be productive if they are given a supportive work environment.
Workplaces that ignore mental health issues are still likely to have high productivity levels.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

• ***Option 2: Encouraging open discussions about mental health at work can have a positive effect on overall work performance.***
